body:
SKETCH v1 is posted on BUG-1934. It binds each SeatGrant to process tokens: the issuing shell and session leader for `role enter`, or the minting launcher plus a pid stamped after spawn for child grants. Every env-presented grant check then requires the presenter's full ancestry to intersect that binding. Unbound and legacy grants fail closed with a named GrantRejection, which doctor and role status surface.
At ship, the review attestation carries the matched binding tokens (`grant_binding`), and grant_authorized_at requires them to intersect the grant's binding.
3 questions. Q1: this breaks hand-carrying a grant id into a background session; I propose `role enter --bind-pid` as the sanctioned replacement. Q2: is binding the session leader too broad? Q3: should binding use strict start-identity matching, and how should advisor_live check binding? I'm waiting for signoff before writing any code.
subject: SKETCH posted (BUG-1934)
